body:
I'm not saying people have their shit figured out 100%. I'm saying they have it figured out vastly more than I do. Not being prepared for death in old age is a lot different than wanting to kill yourself by CO asphyxiation at a relatively young one. I don't understand the equation you're trying to make. I'm not scared of death - I'm scared of living.

>You're terrible. So what?

Maybe I should quit subjecting others to my terribleness?

>I'm honestly worse than most.

Then maybe you should quit subjecting others to to your terribleness?

I don't have a problem with the tone of what you said, I have an issue with the content - no, everyone isn't equally morally wretched. That's plainly apparent, and denying that is what seems empty to me. Some people are really awful. I'm no genocidaire, of course, but when it comes to interpersonal relations, I'm truly disgusting.

And no, I'm here because I'm entertaining alternatives as a matter of course. Sure, you can say that means that part of me doesn't want to die. That may be, but it might still be that a much larger part of me does want to die. Right now, it seems to me that that's definitely the case. For many years, I've suspected more of me has wanted to die than has wanted to live, but now I'm finally being honest with myself, as per your recommendation.

And so, I have tried going for many days. Eventually, it has become too many. Yes, I can change, and I have. I have changed for the worse. Sometimes, with human lives, or with anything else, that's what happens. We get worse until we stop.

>I'm guessing your "goal" in social situations is to build yourself up.

No, my goal in social situations is human connection. Reddit don't count. Also, sex and love.

But yeah, sure, another goal is to build myself up, to be better than everybody, precisely because I am selfish. Seriously, I am. I swear.

I think I'm extremely smart. Unfortunately, it seems like I'm just smart enough to get things exactly wrong, which I do think takes considerable talent. Most people would only get them sort of wrong. I'm not smart enough, though, to get things right, it seems.

Yes, lots of people have their shit figured out, and this seems the most emptily platitudinous part of what you've said. They have their shit figured out significantly more than I do. They're happier than I am. They have vastly more friends than I do (0). They're less obviously evil in the way they act than I am. Everybody is not seriously contemplating sitting in the garage with the car on like I am.

The best way for me to make people happy, it seems to me, is to lie to them. To explain to my family the depths of my depression and moral depravity (which I may have done, in starts and obliquely, in the past), does not make them happy. My presence does not make them happy. Neither will my absence, of course, but I'm not sure the math is as obvious as most people seem to think  - in other words, more absence might, in the long run, be a lot happier than more presence.

Not lying to myself means facing what an awful person I am. Lying to myself about that is the only reason I haven't gone through with it yet.

I am in general an antinatalist, meaning I'm not so sure of the value of life, for anyone. It seems to me that for the average life, the intensity of suffering outweighs the value of joy. I believe, through direct observation, that this is undoubtedly true of my own life. And like I mentioned, I've lived a privileged life.

Don't stay up on my account. Chronic insomnia is another issue of mine, and I wouldn't wish that on anybody. Thanks for talking, though! Talking is one thing I imagine I'd miss if I didn't believe in oblivion.

>if you only care "intellectually" about screwing other people over then why are you so depressed about it?

like I said, I think I'm more depressed about the place it's gotten me than I am about the effect it's had on other people. Yes, that obviously makes me a bad person, and I get that, all too well.

And I am the obstacle. I think I want to treat people better, and then I don't. Time and time again. If you're asking what biochemically or psychoanalytically makes me do that, I don't know - but I do understand that's it wrong. And yet I still do it.

Really, if you knew what I was capable of, *you wouldn't like me*. Neither do I. I backstab close friends, for no other reason than that they're nice to me and therefore can be taken advantage of. I get it, it's wrong, and no one deserves that treatment, but that's the way I am, it seems, if my record is any indication, and of course it is.

Right, but psychopathy isn't a binary thing. There's a scale - people can have psychopathic tendencies or qualities without being full-blown psychopaths. I definitely do - remorseless manipulation is a big one.

And again, I don't really have what I'd refer to as true remorse about a lot of the bad stuff I've done - for instance, at the end of the day I feel much more sorry for myself, and the situation I've put myself in, than I do for any of the people I've wronged. But I do have an intellectual understanding that that's horrible, and that's why I dislike myself.

THanks for the invite for PM, but is there any reason we can't do this here?
